name: SEO Inspector
description: Checks every page when it is saved: title length, meta description, image alt text, headings, thin content and long URLs. Shows a 0-100 score and the warnings per page in the site settings.

panels.title: SEO Inspector
panels.description: A score from 0 to 100 and a list of warnings for every page, updated each time a page is saved.

fields.name: report
fields.title: Page reports
fields.description: Worst score first. Save a page to refresh its report. Editing this text changes nothing.

fields.name: min-words
fields.title: Thin content below
fields.description: Pages with fewer words than this are flagged as thin. 300 is a common rule of thumb.

fields.name: max-title
fields.title: Longest title
fields.description: Characters before search results cut a title off. Around 60.

fields.name: max-url
fields.title: Longest URL
fields.description: Characters in the page path before it counts as long.
